holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Anup Bagchi took charge as Managing Director and CEO on October 27, 2026, succeeding Sashidhar Jagdishan.
The bank reported Q2 net profit of ₹21,537 crore on revenue of ₹95,132 crore for the quarter ended September 2026.
Group Head of Business Banking Sanjay D’Souza superannuated on October 31, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: HDFC Bank is the fund's largest holding at 8.77%. Its -7.4% 3-month return made it the single largest performance detractor, deducting an estimated -0.65% from fund returns.

watch.text: Watch management execution and operational stability following the leadership transition to MD and CEO Anup Bagchi.

holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the September 2026 quarter reached ₹17,389 crore with total revenue rising to ₹55,992 crore.
ICICI Bank increased fixed deposit interest rates for senior citizens and general depositors.
ICRA and CARE reaffirmed the bank's credit ratings in late October 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 5.19% of the fund, ICICI Bank's mild -2.61% decline over 3 months shielded the fund from steeper drops seen in other financial holdings.

watch.text: Watch appellate proceedings against the Telangana GST order confirming a ₹6.95 lakh penalty.

holdings.name: Laurus Labs Ltd

what_changed.text: September 2026 quarterly net profit reached ₹436 crore as sales rose to ₹2,206 crore, with operating margin expanding to 34%.
The company entered into an agreement to acquire a 60% stake in Galenvs Sciences.
The board approved a dividend payout on October 29, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Laurus Labs is the fund's top contributor over the 3-month period, adding an estimated +1.48% to returns on the back of a 32.45% rally across its 4.55% fund weight.

watch.text: Watch regulatory and closing milestones for the 60% acquisition of Galenvs Sciences.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Reliance reported record Q2 net profit of ₹29,550 crore as quarterly sales reached ₹330,601 crore.
Subsidiary Jio Platforms completed its ₹30,188 crore IPO and listed on October 28, 2026.
The board approved issuance of non-convertible debentures up to ₹15,000 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 4.34% fund weight, the stock declined -10.93% over 3 months, weighing on the Energy & Utilities sleeve despite record headline profit.

watch.text: Watch export flows and refining margins as the company expands fuel exports to Africa and Europe amid West Asia conflicts.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: The bank confirmed a dark-web cyber incident exposing records of 3,897 customers while clarifying customer balances remained secure.
A board meeting was scheduled for November 3, 2026 to approve Q2 FY27 financial results.

holdings.why_it_matters: SBI accounts for 4.09% of the fund. Its -6.38% 3-month return contributed to overall drag across the 32.5% Financials sector allocation.

watch.text: Watch Q2 FY27 results and asset quality numbers from the board meeting on November 3, 2026.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Q2 net profit came in at ₹7,666 crore with revenue rising to ₹38,087 crore for the quarter ended September 2026.
SEBI issued a final regulatory order censuring subsidiary Axis Capital on October 28, 2026.
Independent Director Girish Paranjpe retired from the board on November 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighted at 3.66%, Axis Bank posted a -1.02% 3-month return, producing a minor estimated drag of -0.04% on fund performance.

watch.text: Watch customer transaction activity following revisions to savings account charges and free limits starting December 1, 2026.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: TRAI imposed a ₹54.06 lakh financial disincentive for alleged December 2024 compliance issues.
DoT Karnataka levied a ₹2.14 lakh penalty regarding subscriber verification norm violations.
The company scheduled a board meeting on November 5, 2026 to review Q2 and H1 audited results.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 3.60% weight, Bharti Airtel stayed broadly flat over 3 months (+0.09%), offering steady valuation support within the Technology bucket.

watch.text: Watch the outcome of the November 5, 2026 board meeting for Q2 and H1 FY27 financial performance.

holdings.name: Delhivery Ltd

what_changed.text: Delhivery swung to a net profit of ₹41 crore in Q2 FY27 from a loss of ₹50 crore a year prior, as revenue crossed ₹3,066 crore.
Express parcel shipment volumes grew 32.1% year-on-year in Q2 FY27.
The board cleared an investment of up to ₹36 crore in DFDPL.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.41% position, Delhivery's -19.91% drop over 3 months subtracted an estimated -0.48% from fund returns, making it one of the largest bottom contributors.

watch.text: Watch progress on the approved investment of up to ₹36 crore in DFDPL.

holdings.name: Hindalco Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Hindalco and wholly owned subsidiary Novelis Inc scheduled earnings conference calls for Q2 FY27 results.
The company partnered with Vi Business to establish a private network at its Odisha bauxite mine.
NSE Sustainability Ratings assigned Hindalco an ESG rating of 68.

holdings.why_it_matters: Hindalco represents 2.40% of fund assets; its -9.21% 3-month return reflects pressure inside the fund's 9.2% Materials allocation.

watch.text: Watch Q2 FY27 operating margins and commentary during the upcoming earnings calls of Hindalco and Novelis.

holdings.name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Q2 FY27 net profit declined to ₹1,995 crore after accounting for a ₹922.7 crore antitrust settlement charge and Organon deal expenses.
Regulators ordered Sun Pharma to halt eye-care drug production at an Indian facility following quality findings.
Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP was approved as statutory auditor for a five-year term.

holdings.why_it_matters: Sun Pharma carries a 2.34% weight; its -10.69% 3-month drop offset gains from other healthcare positions like Laurus Labs.

watch.text: Watch regulatory updates concerning the production halt at the eye-care manufacturing facility.

portfolio.statement: Mirae Asset ELSS Tax Saver Fund declined -6.85% over the past 3 months, pressured by broad pullbacks in private banks, industrials, and energy.
interp: Significant gains in CDMO healthcare holding Laurus Labs softened portfolio drawdowns.
Underperformance in key large-cap holdings like HDFC Bank and Reliance Industries dragged on overall returns.
portfolio.line: Healthcare outperformance offset by heavy drawdowns across major Financials and Industrials holdings.

drivers.text: Laurus Labs surged 32.45% over 3 months after reporting a 126% YoY profit rise and expanding operating margins to 34%.
HDFC Bank fell -7.4% over 3 months while undergoing executive leadership turnover at the MD & CEO level.
Delhivery dropped -19.91% over 3 months despite turning profitable with ₹41 crore net income in Q2 FY27.
Reliance Industries dropped -10.93% over 3 months following its record Q2 net profit and Jio Platforms listing.

Jio Platforms' listing following its ₹30,188 crore IPO completion.
Sun Pharma's ₹922.7 crore exceptional charge for antitrust settlement costs and Organon deal expenses.
